tldr.en: Encode proprioceptive history into a latent source and transport it toward future actions instead of starting from Gaussian noise.
tldr.zh: 将本体动作历史编码为潜在生成起点，向未来动作迁移，替代从高斯噪声开始的生成。

evaluation_scope.en: Visuomotor policy and temporal-generation experiments. Timing protocol and adaptation to π0.5 remain to be checked.
evaluation_scope.zh: 视觉运动策略与时序生成实验；计时口径及 π0.5 适配条件待核对。
